- **Photo-realism**: 8K NASA Blue Marble day imagery, terrain normal mapping, specular sun glint on oceans, an animated 8K cloud layer, a custom atmospheric-scattering shell (blue rim shading into sunset orange at the terminator), and a Milky Way sky — all through custom GLSL shaders with ACES tone mapping.
